_comment: Shared contract for the quarantine->regular-storage path transform, duplicated by design (security isolation, see audit C-Niedrig-3) in backend/app/services/submission_service.py::_move_from_quarantine and abgabebox-backend/app/storage.py::move_from_quarantine. Both strip the leading 'quarantine' path segment and keep everything after it. Tested here against backend's copy (see test_submission_service_quarantine_parity.py); abgabebox-backend has no test harness yet, so its copy isn't independently verified against this fixture - if you add one, point it at this same file.
